title: 6.02 / Store Locator
slide_intent: Give contributors one place to obtain local details so customers receive consistent addresses and opening hours.
strategic_value: A shared lookup source can reduce conflicting store information across Spectrum retail materials.
demonstration: A short locator instruction sits over a large webpage screenshot with a location search and United States map.
practical_value: Use a store locator as the source for local information rather than copying it from unrelated collateral.

content_islands.name: Heading and locator direction
content_islands.spec: Place the title upper left and lookup instruction to its right.

content_islands.name: Locator screenshot
content_islands.spec: Place the large webpage capture in the lower middle, retaining search controls, map and site navigation.
